title: Bounds for the odd symmetrized value
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$ with $-1\le f(y)\le 1$ for every cube point $y$, and let $x$ be any point of that cube. For either choice of whether to negate, the value is $f(x)$ when no negation is chosen and $-f(-x)$ when negation is chosen; in both cases it lies in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is defined on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
The negation choice is either true or false
